name: DISCOVERY_WEEKDAY_SEASONALITY_TOURNAMENT

rationale.stage0011_outcome: 0 robust leads across 30 close-to-close sign-sequence serial-dependence hypotheses
rationale.structural_change: move to deterministic calendar seasonality; trigger depends only on weekday of first available H1 bar of each calendar date, never on price direction/magnitude/range/wick/breakout/RSI/ATR regime

signal_definition.trigger: first available completed H1 bar of each calendar date whose datetime.weekday equals configured weekday
signal_definition.direction: fixed LONG for weekday_long; fixed SHORT for weekday_short; direction is not inferred from price
signal_definition.entry: next available H1 bar open after trigger
signal_definition.exit: fixed number of instrument H1 bars later
signal_definition.cooldown: hold_bars; one active event per instrument/config
signal_definition.atr: simple ATR14 at signal only for normalization; ATR is not a trigger
signal_definition.cost: observed entry spread converted to price and divided by ATR14

eligibility_notes.closed_weekend_markets: Saturday/Sunday hypotheses naturally have no events and fail; they are retained because the family was preregistered uniformly across all discovery categories

neighbor_definition: same family; exactly one parameter moves one adjacent predefined grid step; weekday adjacency is calendar adjacent within [Mon..Sun] without wrap; hold adjacency is [8,24,72]; good if equal-symbol mean>0, stress2>0, pooled trim1>0

ranking: highest robustness_floor = min(stress3_equal_symbol, trim5_pooled, half1_equal_symbol, half2_equal_symbol)

next_if_frozen: STAGE0013 extracts validation pool only and applies exact frozen candidate; no discovery retuning
next_if_no_lead: continue discovery with another structurally distinct family; validation stays locked
